Subject: OmegaAI POC — post-call recap & next steps

Hi Samir / Olivia —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can get the POC lined up: 

Scope & goal
- Objective: Validate Redwood inference on OmegaAI’s summarization pipeline at 99th percentile latency <= 250ms and cost < $0.001/token for 1k QPS simulated load.
- Primary dataset: internal support tickets (sample you mentioned) + a 10k-row evaluation set.

Success criteria (initial)
- Latency: p99 < 250ms for 1k QPS (region: us-west)
- Quality: ROUGE/L or expert review score >= baseline by 5% (we’ll define metric with Rachel)
- Cost: expected token cost reduction vs current endpoint

Proposed timeline & owners
- Week of Mar 1: dataset delivery (OmegaAI) — Olivia owner
- Mar 2–6: infra setup & ingestion — Marcus owner
- Mar 9–13: run evals, report — Rachel & Marissa
- Mar 16: final review & recommendations — Marissa

Deliverables we’ll provide
- POC runbook + evaluation template (attached: redwood_poc_template.xlsx)
- Proposed infra architecture and scope doc (attached: omegaai_poc_scope.pdf)

Requests from you
- Confirm dataset delivery date and access method (S3 link, DropBox, or shared Drive)
- Any constraints (data sensitivity / columns to mask)

If that looks good I’ll send a short SOW + schedule and we can kick off first thing March 2.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: omegaai_poc_scope.pdf (application/pdf), redwood_poc_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Samir — thanks, noted. I updated the POC plan and attached a short success-criteria doc with measurable checks (see attached: omegaai_poc_success_criteria.pdf). High level changes: 

- Quality metrics: Rachel will run ROUGE/L + a small 200-example blind expert review for faithfulness scoring. Target: >=5% improvement over baseline or matched baseline with 30% lower cost.
- Latency: Marcus will provision a dedicated test pool for the run to hit 1k QPS and we’ll measure p50/p95/p99 per run.
- Data delivery: Olivia to share a sanitized sample via pre-signed S3 by EOD Mar 1.

Short checklist for kickoff week (Mar 2–6):
- [Marcus] Create test cluster + IAM roles, share endpoint SSH/key — due Mar 2
- [Olivia] Upload sanitized sample to S3 + share presigned link — due Mar 1
- [Rachel] Finalize eval script + baseline metrics — due Mar 4

I’ve also added the POC runbook to a shared folder for visibility: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cOmegaAIPoC

If there are no objections I’ll send a brief SOW and calendar invites for the weekly Monday checkpoints.

Thanks,
Marissa
